name: Mochizuki Rinka
source:
The hard-working Class President and friend of Haruka and Ikuya. Despite the contrast in personalities she gets along well with both of them, though it is a mystery how.

She does repeatedly hit Ikuya with a textbook when he gets out of hand or is being a fool (which is often).
